home.title: Project ready!
home.intro: You may now add components and start building.
home.componentNote: We've already added the button component for you.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Manage staff members and their weekly availability.
staff.emptyDescription: Add your first staff member to start building schedules.
staff.newDescription: Add staff details and weekly availability.
staff.editDescription: Update staff details and weekly availability.

form.detailsDescription: These fields describe the staff member.
form.availabilityDescription: Leave a day empty when the staff member is not available that day.

detail.groupsDescription: Groups this staff member can be scheduled in.
detail.availabilityHoursMismatch: Available hours total {availableHours}h, but max hours per week is {maxHours}h.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Manage groups and their minimum staffing rules.
groups.emptyDescription: Add your first group to define staffing needs.
groups.newDescription: Add a group name and weekly staff rules.
groups.editDescription: Update the group name and staff rules.

form.name: Name
form.rulesDescription: Add the minimum staffing needed for each weekday time range. Every rule must fit within one opening-hours interval.
form.applyRulesToAllWeekdays: Apply the same rules to all weekdays
form.applyRulesToAllWeekdaysDescription: Edit one shared set of rules that will be saved separately for Monday through Friday.

detail.subtitle: Minimum staffing rules
detail.staffDescription: Active staff members linked to this group.
detail.noStaff: No staff members have been linked.
detail.allStaffLinked: All active staff members are already linked.
detail.noRules: No staff rules have been added.
detail.totalCapacityShortfall: This group is short {hours} staff hours this week based on current staffing rules and linked staff capacity.
detail.pedagogCapacityShortfall: This group is short {hours} pedagog hours this week based on current staffing rules and linked pedagog staff capacity.

openingHours.title: Institution opening hours
openingHours.description: Configure the global hours when shifts may be scheduled. Add multiple intervals for split opening hours, or leave a day closed. Existing staffing rules must remain inside one interval.

shiftSchedule.title: Shift schedule
shiftSchedule.description: Preview the opening hours and group data used to generate a shift schedule.
shiftSchedule.savedPlansDescription: Open a previously generated shift schedule plan.
shiftSchedule.savedPlansEmptyDescription: Generate a shift schedule plan to save it here.
shiftSchedule.savedPlanDetailDescription: Review the saved shifts and plan metadata.
shiftSchedule.emptyDescription: Choose a group to preview linked staff, availability, and staff rules as JSON.
shiftSchedule.noGroups: Create a group before previewing shift schedule data.
shiftSchedule.generatedDescription: Generate a preview plan from institution opening hours and the selected group's staff, availability, and staffing rules.
shiftSchedule.generatedEmptyDescription: Generate a plan to see validated AI output here.
shiftSchedule.calendarDescription: Shift placement and duration on a shared timeline.
shiftSchedule.invalidGroup: The selected group id is not valid. Choose a group from the list.
shiftSchedule.groupNotFound: That group could not be found. Choose another group from the list.

validation.title: Validation errors
validation.description: These hard rule violations block the plan from being saved.
validation.group_id_mismatch: The plan was generated for a different group.
validation.duplicate_weekday: {day} appears more than once in the plan.
validation.staffing_rule_outside_opening_hours: The {day} staffing rule {start}-{end} does not fit inside one opening hours interval.
validation.unknown_staff: The plan schedules a staff member who is not linked to this group.
validation.inactive_staff: {name} is inactive and cannot be scheduled.
validation.invalid_shift_time: The {day} shift {start}-{end} has an invalid time range.
validation.outside_availability: {name} is scheduled {start}-{end} on {day}, which does not fit inside one availability interval.
validation.max_hours_exceeded: {name} is scheduled for more than their weekly maximum hours.
validation.shift_outside_opening_hours: {name} is scheduled {start}-{end} on {day}, outside institution opening hours.
validation.fifo_end_order_inversion: {name} starts later but ends earlier than a colleague on {day}.
validation.min_staff_unmet: {day} {start}-{end} does not have enough staff for staffing rule {number}.
validation.min_pedagogs_unmet: {day} {start}-{end} does not have enough pedagogs for staffing rule {number}.

readiness.title: Group readiness
readiness.description: Checked before generating, so problems surface without spending an AI call.
readiness.readyDescription: This group has everything needed to generate a schedule plan.

blocking.no_opening_hours: The institution has no opening hours configured.
blocking.no_staffing_rules: This group has no staffing rules.
blocking.no_linked_active_staff: This group has no linked active staff members.
blocking.staffing_rule_outside_opening_hours: The {day} staffing rule {start}-{end} does not fit inside one opening hours interval.

capacity.staffDescription: Linked active staff can work {capacity} hours per week, but staffing rules require {demand} hours. Short by {shortfall} hours.
capacity.pedagogDescription: Linked active pedagogs can work {capacity} hours per week, but staffing rules require {demand} pedagog hours. Short by {shortfall} hours.
capacity.note: This is a group-level concern. It does not decide whether a generated plan can be accepted.

verdict.acceptedDescription: This plan has zero validation errors and can be saved.
verdict.blockedDescription: {count, plural, one {# validation error blocks} other {# validation errors block}} this plan from being saved.

failure.title: Plan could not be generated
failure.invalid_group: Choose a valid group before generating a plan.
failure.group_not_found: That group could not be found. Choose another group.
failure.input_not_supported: This group's data cannot be scheduled yet.
failure.invalid_review: That plan could not be read. Generate a new plan and try again.
failure.plan_no_longer_valid: This plan no longer passes validation against current group data. Generate a new plan.
failure.gateway_not_configured: AI Gateway is not configured. Add AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY to .env.local, then restart the dev server.
failure.schema_mismatch: The AI returned a response that did not match the schedule schema. Try generating again.
failure.gateway_auth: AI Gateway authentication failed. Check that AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY is valid, then restart the dev server.
failure.model_rejected: AI Gateway rejected the model "{detail}". Choose a model enabled for your account.
failure.database: The plan could not be saved to the database. Check that the latest migrations have been applied.
failure.unknown: The plan could not be generated because AI Gateway returned an unknown error.

shiftSchedule.aiWarningsDescription: Notes from the model. They are not validation results and do not decide whether this plan is accepted.
shiftSchedule.validationWarningsDescription: Non-blocking concerns. They do not prevent this plan from being saved.
shiftSchedule.reviewDescription: Nothing is saved until you accept this plan.
shiftSchedule.generatingDescription: Producing a plan and checking it against the staffing rules.
shiftSchedule.generateBlockedReason: Resolve the group readiness problems above before generating a plan.
